explanation: Eta kinematics W=1.7 GeV (above eta threshold ~1.486 GeV), Q2=1.0 GeV2, cos=0, phi=90 deg are inside the EtaMAID-2023 table range (W 1.4856-6 GeV, Q2 0-5 GeV2) and physically allowed at bmom=6.53 GeV. vcut=-0.1 was applied as requested, but raises a known risk: the input format documents negative vcut as a direct v-cut rather than a v2 cut, however the Fortran source (bornkin) only imposes vmax=min(vmax,cutv) when cutv>1d-12; for -0.1 it is ignored, so the code runs with the full kinematic inelasticity range (same as vcut=0). Because v (energy transfer) is positive-definite, a negative cut threshold is physically meaningless, so if the intent was to restrict inelasticity to 0.1 GeV2 the value should be positive (e.g. 0.1). File produced with correct 10-point limit (1 point), model=3, ivec=1, full RC, and required legacy trailing error line.
